defs.def: something that is done to cure an illness or injury, or to make sb look and feel good 治疗；疗法；诊治；护理

ex.s: “We should be looking into upgrading drinking water treatment plants so they remove microplastics.”
ex.t: 根据日程安排，青少年可以参加以下哪项活动？

ex.s: He became interested in alternative treatments 20 years ago when he suffered from terrible back pain.
ex.t: 20年前，当他遭受严重背痛时，他对替代疗法产生了兴趣。

ex.s: Then he tried acupuncture, an ancient Chinese practice, and was amazed that he improved after two or three treatments.
ex.t: 然后他尝试了针灸——一种古老的中国疗法，并惊讶地发现治疗两三次后他就好转了。

ex.s: After Charlie had a heart attack, Tindale says, she was prepared to put him to sleep, but Farber’s treatments eased her dog’s suffering so much that she was able to keep him alive for an additional five months.
ex.t: 廷代尔说，查理心脏病发作后，她本已准备让它安乐死，但法伯的治疗极大地缓解了她的狗的痛苦，使她能让它多活了五个月。

ex.s: “They were the best chance for many rural people to get the treatment they want. ”
ex.t: "他们是许多农村人获得所需治疗的最好机会。"

ex.s: Your medical history is a list of your illnesses, treatments, what the doctors told you to do, and anything else you think your doctor should know.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 不要害怕向医生提出你有任何问题。

ex.s: in the future，the team hopes to develop a version of the technology that can be sprayed onto plant leaves in a one-off treatment that would last the plant’s lifetime.
ex.t: 工程师们还在研发一种"开关"，当暴露在日光下时发光会减弱。

ex.s: One nonprofit organization, which monitors the treatment or animals in filmed entertainment, is keeping tabs on more than 2,000 productions this year.
ex.t: 一个监控影视娱乐中动物待遇的非营利组织今年正在跟踪2000多部制作。

ex.s: In some cases, it’s not so much the treatment of the animals on set in the studio that has activists worried; it’s the off-set training and living conditions that are raising concerns.
ex.t: 在某些情况下，让活动家担心的不一定是摄影棚内动物的待遇问题；而是场外的训练和生活条件引发了担忧。

ex.s: Later, he worked in Africa, where many people suffered from ______48______ for lack of proper treatment.
ex.t: 后来，他在非洲工作，那里许多人因缺乏适当治疗而____48____受苦。

ex.s: To appeal for equal rights in medical treatment.
ex.t: 解决安全问题以便推进AI发展似乎是可能的但并不容易。

defs.def: a way of behaving towards or dealing with a person or thing 对待；待遇
a way of dealing with or discussing a subject, work of art, etc. 处理；讨论；论述

ex.s: You can talk to another doctor if the treatments don't work.
ex.src: 2020全国新高考II卷·Talking with your doctor
ex.t: 看医生之前，记录下你的感受。

defs.def: a process by which sth is cleaned, or protected against sth （净化或防治）处理，加工

ex.s: Jane received the surgery, and things got extremely hard during the two-year treatment that followed – she couldn’t even remember how many times she was rushed to the ICU.
ex.t: 简接受了手术，在随后两年的治疗期间情况极其艰难——她甚至不记得自己被紧急送进重症监护室多少次。

ex.s: Then one day, I had to go through a two-hour medical treatment.
ex.t: 后来有一天，我不得不接受一次长达两小时的医疗治疗。

ex.s: Artemisinin has become a vital part of the treatment for malaria, and is thought to save 100,000 lives a year in Africa alone.
ex.t: 青蒿素已成为疟疾治疗的重要组成部分，据估计仅在非洲一年就能挽救 10 万人的生命。

ex.s: In 1967, the Chinese government formed a team of scientists with the objective of discovering a new treatment for malaria, and Tu Youyou was among the first researchers chosen.
ex.t: 1967 年，中国政府组建了一支科学家团队，目标是发现治疗疟疾的新方法，屠呦呦是首批入选的研究人员之一。

ex.s: In 1969, she became the head of the project in Beijing, and decided to review ancient Chinese medical texts to find traditional botanical treatments for the disease.
ex.t: 1969 年，她成为该项目在北京的负责人，并决定查阅中国古代医籍，寻找治疗这种疾病的传统植物疗法。
